text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling and fewer evenings spent updating the CRM.

**2. Notes got better, not just faster.** Capturing exact customer wording surfaced objections we'd been paraphrasing away.

**3. Consent matters.** Some customers hesitated at first. A short, upfront heads-up solved it every time.

**4. Managers coached differently.** Reviewing call snippets beat ride-alongs for spotting patterns.

**5. Adoption took leadership.** Usage rose only after managers used the summaries in pipeline reviews.

The tool didn't change how we sell. It changed what we could see.

What's your team learning from AI pilots?
